data.one_liner: Dart client for the Open Food Facts REST API.
data.what_it_does: Provides typed objects and functions to read, search and edit food product data from the Open Food Facts database. Handles authentication, suggestions, and various product‑related endpoints.
use_when: You need to fetch or submit food product information from Open Food Facts.
You want a cross‑platform Dart/Flutter solution with ready‑made models and API helpers.
avoid_when: You require offline‑only storage without network calls.
You need a UI widget library rather than an API client.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Open Food Facts endpoints (read, write, search, suggestions).
Typed models generated via json_annotation for easy use.
Works on all Flutter platforms (mobile, web, desktop).
weaknesses: No built‑in caching; you must add your own solution.
Relies on the public API – rate limits or downtime affect your app.
Only useful for Open Food Facts; not a generic networking client.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml; run `flutter pub get`. If you want generated JSON code, run `flutter pub run build_runner build`. No special permissions required.
